packages.title: Snackbars time out and never outlive their screen
files: every other App/lib file that builds a SnackBar (grep -rn 'SnackBar(' App/lib: about 70 call sites in 19 files)
brief: Why: in Flutter 3.44 a SnackBar with an action never times out unless `persist: false` is set (SDK material/snack_bar.dart:303, scaffold.dart:622), and snackbars live on the root messenger, so they follow the user onto the next screen. Only task completion is right today (App/lib/widgets/task_interactions.dart:19-31: `persist: false` plus `duration: await FeedbackTimeout.forAction()`), and it is also the only snackbar that honours Android's accessibility timeout.

1. Add one helper beside FeedbackTimeout (App/lib/services/feedback_timeout.dart, or App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart if it needs widgets), for example `showFeedback(messenger, text, {actionLabel, onAction})`. It hides the current snackbar, awaits `FeedbackTimeout.forAction()`, then shows a floating SnackBar with `persist: false` and that duration. Later packages in this run use it for every new message, so give it an obvious name.

2. Route every SnackBar in App/lib through the helper, keeping each message and action exactly as it is. The ones with an action today: review_tasks_screen.dart:160 (voice save `1 tarea guardada · Deshacer`, with a hard-coded 8 s — drop it), review_tasks_screen.dart:236 (`Borrador retirado`), task_interactions.dart:87 (move), task_editor.dart:245 (`Sugerencia de fecha aplicada`).

3. UX-101: when a capture opens (VoiceTaskScreen) and when ReviewTasksScreen is pushed, call `ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).hideCurrentSnackBar()`, so a stale `Deshacer` never floats above `Guardar tarea` and can't undo an earlier save and push the old review back (review_tasks_screen.dart:190-200).

4. UX-207 (merged into UX-101): TaskEditor `_save` (task_editor.dart:268 onward) clears the current snackbar before its save message, so the message isn't queued behind `Sugerencia de fecha aplicada`. That suggestion's Undo must not outlive the form: hide it when the form closes.

5. UX-416: the home-screen widget instructions in Settings (settings_screen.dart:184-198, strings `homeCaptureInstructions` and `widgetPickerHelp`, 26–29 words) vanish after 4 s. Show them in a bottom sheet that stays until the user closes it: the same text and one button with the existing `done` string. data_transfer_screen.dart:51, subscription_screen.dart:28 and main.dart:187 go through the helper like the rest.

6. UX-335: remove `behavior: SnackBarBehavior.fixed` from task_lists_screen.dart (:185, :206, :219, :272) and from data_transfer_screen.dart, so every snackbar floats above the bottom bar (test/calendar_feedback_test.dart:170-173 asserts this on Calendar).
Don't change any message's wording or what any Undo does: later packages reword messages.

packages.title: Speech hints for the recognizer and the assistant (U6, app side)
brief: Source: UX_REVIEW.md §4, layers 2 and 3 (one folder above the repo). It is not part of the open capture direction (§3, D3). App side only: Backend/ is out of scope.

Recognizer biasing: in NativeSpeechBridge.kt `intent()` (:39-46), on API 33 and above, add `RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_BIASING_STRINGS` with an ArrayList passed from Dart in the `start` call. Build the list in Dart for the speech language: weekday and month names (intl DateFormat symbols for that locale); the words for today, tomorrow, the day after tomorrow and next week; morning, afternoon, evening and AM/PM words; and the user's own project names and the names of the people in their groups and shared projects (taskListsProvider and the projects' people). Keep it to about 100 short strings. Below API 33 send nothing. AOSP says the effect depends on the recognizer.

Speech or typed: in capture_processor.dart:84-90, add a request field `source` with the value `speech` when the words came from the microphone (live transcript or recorded audio) and `typed` for typed or shared text. Before sending it, read the capture endpoint in Backend/core (views and serializers) and confirm it ignores unknown fields. If it would reject the field, don't send it, and report that the server needs it first.

Server side (report it; don't change it): Backend/core/ai.py's prompt needs the speech-only instruction from UX_REVIEW §4 layer 3, and typed text must never be ‘repaired’. U6's full acceptance — sound-alike cases such as ‘fry them at five’ produce the intended date or a question — depends on that change.
Don't touch: the session mode and endpointing (U1, D3), any UI.
acceptance: Code: on API 33+ the recognizer intent carries EXTRA_BIASING_STRINGS built from the speech language's weekday and month names, the day words, and the user's project and people names; nothing is added below API 33.
Unit test: the hint list for es-ES contains `viernes`, `mañana` and a project name from the test data; for ca-ES it contains `divendres`.
Unit test: a spoken capture request carries source `speech` and a typed or shared one `typed` — or the implementer reports why the field can't be sent yet.
U6 is judged on its app side here; the prompt change is server-side and stays in the ledger.
deviceChecks: On a physical Android 13+ phone, say ‘llamar al médico el viernes a las cinco’ ten times with and without biasing and compare how often ‘viernes’ is heard. Recognizer-dependent: measure it.

packages.title: Reminder notifications say when, and can be undone
brief: UX-409: notification bodies are relative and go stale (reminder_engine.dart:189-196 and :314): `Programada dentro de 10 minutos.` is wrong 20 minutes later, the deadline text doesn't say when, and after a snooze the body becomes `Tu tarea pospuesta.` Lead with the absolute time, in the alert's language and with the stored 12/24-hour choice:

decisions.question: Unfinished tasks from earlier days vanish from Today (S4). Carry them into Today under `Atrasadas · N` (with their date, counted in ‘pendientes’ and the Tareas ‘Hoy’ filter, a repeating task showing only its latest missed occurrence), or leave them on their date with one link `N sin hacer de días anteriores ›`?
decisions.recommendation: Carry them into Today. It's what other task apps do, and it needs no extra tap.

decisions.question: Reminders are off for every new account and only Ajustes asks for Android's permission (S4). (a) At the first saved task with a date, ask once ‘¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?’ — ‘Sí, recuérdamelo’ turns reminders on and asks Android in the same tap. (b) Once on, date-only tasks remind at 9:00 (an editable default). (c) Apply for Google Play's USE_EXACT_ALARM, allowed for calendar apps, so on-time reminders skip the ‘Alarmas y recordatorios’ screen?
decisions.recommendation: Yes to (a) and (b). (c) Yes if the Play listing presents TaskFlow as a calendar app; otherwise P8's one-sentence ask covers it. P8 ships without these: the chip says ‘Sin recordatorio · Activar’ and one tap turns reminders on.

decisions.question: Approve the capture direction in UX_REVIEW §3? Listening ends only on Done (U1, U2); capture opens as a sheet with one mic (U3); the result shows in that sheet with the date as its main line (U4); the calendar lands on the saved task (U5); ‘Guardar tal cual’ when the AI is slow or fails (U7); capture options leave the screen and the Task/Note choice goes, with a new Ajustes › Voz (U9).
decisions.recommendation: Approve it. At minimum approve U1 — the pause that stopped your father — and U5, which can reuse the landing P7 builds for typed saves. Approving also unblocks U8, U12, the timeline's ‘+’ (UX-224) and Discard folding into Cancel (UX-126).

decisions.question: Pro and the single Add button: (a) once U8 leaves one ‘Añadir tarea’, should users without Pro get free typing in that sheet (local date parser) or the paywall? (b) Should the first few voice captures be free? (c) Is your father's account Pro or complimentary? (d) The Pro screen shows four secondary buttons — keep only ‘Ver suscripción’ and ‘Restaurar compras’ (UX-423)?
findings: UX-423 (Pro-screen part; the rest is in P18)
decisions.recommendation: (a) Free typing; voice and AI stay Pro. (b) Your pricing call. (c) Tell us: if it's Pro, the 10-minute test won't show the wall other newcomers meet. (d) Keep ‘Gestionar suscripción’ for paying users too, drop ‘Abrir suscripciones de la tienda’, and refresh the status automatically instead of ‘Actualizar estado’. P5 already lets the current Pro wall open the free typed editor; nothing paid changes.

decisions.question: Where should the sun–moon switch live? It's on 23 surfaces today: (a) Ajustes › Apariencia only (first run follows the phone), (b) the Calendar header only, or (c) the avatar menu.
decisions.recommendation: (a). P18 already makes Apariencia one row (Claro / Oscuro / Como el teléfono), which works with any answer. U10's limit of 15 tap targets also needs this and U8; P6 and P25 remove 6 targets meanwhile.

decisions.question: Names: (a) approve UX_REVIEW §5.4's renames — ‘Bandeja de entrada’ (no date) → ‘Sin fecha’, ‘Capturas pendientes’ → ‘Sin guardar’, drop ‘Lista para cuando tú quieras’; (b) call the no-project bucket ‘Personal’ (§5.4) or ‘Sin proyecto’ (UX-311)?; (c) keep ‘Proyectos’ (decided 2026-10-11) or call personal containers ‘Listas’ (report C)?
decisions.recommendation: (a) Yes. (b) ‘Sin proyecto’, with UX-311's new examples (‘Casa, Trabajo, Compras’) and the ‘Bandeja personal’ chip dropped from Tareas: ‘Personal’ would sit next to the ‘Proyectos personales’ section. (c) Keep ‘Proyectos’ unless your father stumbles on it.

decisions.question: Tabs and Settings: (a) two tabs, Calendario and Listas (search, Sin fecha, projects, Notes, Completed), with Ajustes behind the avatar — or does Notes keep its own tab? (b) If Notes stays, show ‘En Notas: 2’ when a search finds nothing (UX-331)? (c) Settings in six rows by need, with the rare ones in a new ‘Otros ajustes’ screen and ‘Tareas completadas’ moved to Tareas/Listas (UX-404)?
findings: UX-404 (grouping part; the rest is in P18)
decisions.recommendation: (a) Two tabs, after the capture fixes and the §7 test. (b) Only if Notes stays a tab. (c) Yes. P18 already puts Recordatorios first and removes the noise.

decisions.question: Sign-in order (U14): option 1, Google first with one line saying what TaskFlow does; or option 2, use the app before signing in?
decisions.recommendation: Option 1 now; revisit option 2 after the §7 test. P17's sign-in fixes apply either way. App/test/auth_gate_test.dart, which locks Google below the email form, changes with option 1.

decisions.question: Spoken tasks with no date ignore the day selected in the calendar (‘Nueva tarea’ uses it). Use the selected day, when it isn't today, for spoken tasks with no date?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. U3's sheet will need it anyway. A spoken time without a day needs the server.

decisions.question: Typed dates: ‘Dentista viernes 10:00’ saves on today unless the small ‘Usar vie, 17 oct · 10:00’ chip is tapped. Apply the understood date straight away, with ‘Dejar como está’ one tap away? (A code comment says suggestions are never applied automatically; it isn't a recorded decision.)
Delete: replace the ‘¿Eliminar?’ confirmation, whose filled button is Eliminar, with immediate delete and ‘Tarea eliminada · Deshacer’?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. Keep one confirmation only for deleting a whole repeating series, with ‘Conservar tarea’ as the filled button.

decisions.question: Back in the task form throws away what was typed. (a) Save it — a new task with a title, or an edit with changes — with ‘Cambios guardados · Deshacer’ (an empty form just closes), or (b) ask ‘¿Guardar esta tarea?’?
decisions.recommendation: (a), like the voice path: nothing is lost and there's no extra question.

decisions.question: Developer tools in release builds: hide ‘Diagnóstico de captura’ (P50/P95, a Settings row every user sees) and ‘Detalles de conexión’ (the server URL on Account)?
findings: UX-408 (connection-details part; the rest is in P18)
decisions.recommendation: Debug builds only, plus a long-press on the version line so you keep them on staging.

decisions.question: Invitations need a separately shared code because password sign-up doesn't verify the email (decided 2026-10-11); Google sign-in does. Let an invitee signed in with Google, whose email matches, join without the code? Nothing in this plan waits on it.
decisions.recommendation: Yes, for Google-verified matching emails; keep the code for password accounts. It needs a server change. P14 works either way.

decisions.question: Sharing: (a) should ‘Compartir’ on a project be the only door, creating or reusing a group behind the scenes, with Grupos as an advanced view? (b) Drop the Editor/Viewer choice from the invite dialog (everyone joins as an editor; the role can be changed on the person's row)?
findings: UX-305 (role-choice part; the rest is in P13)
decisions.recommendation: (a) Not now: P13 already puts ‘Compartir’ on the project page; revisit after the §7 test. (b) Yes.
